LESSON: SOIL

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Natural Environment
Topic 2.2: Soil
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Soil, part of Natural Environment in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we care for soil? 2. What can you do to protect our soil?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Soil together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Patriotism: learner enhances awareness of their responsibilities in the society when they engage in tree planting activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Health promotion issues: learner promotes hygiene practices when they wash their hands after manipulating soils.

Link to other learning area:

Characteristics of soils can be used by learners when learning about modelling in Creative Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources

Approved support learning materials, soil samples, manilla paper, glue, pictures, watering cans, tree seedlings, charts, farm tools,

digital devices with assistive technology.
